name: Husbandman
overview: The term 'husbandman' refers to an agriculturist, specifically one who tends and manages a vineyard or land for cultivation. In the parable recorded in Matthew 21:33-38, husbandmen are entrusted with the care of a vineyard and expected to produce fruit for the owner. However, these husbandmen reject and mistreat the servants sent to collect the fruit, ultimately conspiring to kill the owner's son to seize the inheritance. This passage highlights the responsibility and accountability of those entrusted with stewardship, as well as the serious consequences of rejecting God's messengers and His Son.
